messages:
Nina (Sales): Quick heads-up 1: AcmeNova POC next Wed. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk import (~50k users), RBAC sync, and tight audit retention. Two immediate asks: 1) contractor NameID differs (proxy) and 2) SCIM replace semantics at ~400 rps. Pricing: hosted vs dedicated cost ops? @Rach @Priya

Rach (SE): Are contractor NameIDs same issuer but different format or different issuer? If same issuer we can map claims; diff issuer -> aliasing needed.

Marta (Prospect): Contractors use a proxy that emits a different NameID format but same Azure issuer. We'll provide sample CSV and metadata. Sync window ~10m.

Evan (Eng): We support idmap aliasing (issuer+subject -> internal_id). For SCIM bulk we recommend chunked uploads (500/page) to our ingest endpoint which applies idempotent upserts. We'll throttle per-tenant during POC.

Priya (Security): Security notes: hourly token rotation ok if compatible with their proxy. If they require BYO-KMS or HSM-backed keys + segregated audit streams, recommend Private. For throughput and cost predictability Dedicated is usually preferred.

ticket-bot: created POC-8044 "AcmeNova SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing" assigned to eng-platform.

Nina (Sales): I'll schedule a 30m sync Tue 10am PT and attach the security questionnaire. Rach will post a pricing ballpark after ops reply.

Rach (SE): Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool (S1) with burst; mid-five-figure USD/month depending on retention/SLA. Will confirm with pricing-ops and update here.
